faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) for an ICMR-funded research project in Puducherry.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The position available in this notification is Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) under advertisement number REC-02.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) position on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 11 October 2026. Candidates must ensure applications reach before this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree such as a PhD or Masters in Public Health, Epidemiology, or Biostatistics with two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs 80,400.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively via email by sending the filled application form and required documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting based on the application and CV, followed by a written test and an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification details?
faq.answer: You can check the official JIPMER website at www.jipmer.edu.in and download the notification PDF using the direct links provided above.
